definitions.gloss: flower field; flower bed; flower garden
definitions.explanation: A field or area where flowers are grown or bloom in abundance. Can refer to a cultivated flower garden or a natural meadow full of flowers.
Used figuratively and often sarcastically to describe someone whose thinking is naive, unrealistic, or blissfully detached from reality — as if their head is full of flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花畑|はなばたけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The flower fields in spring are beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラベンダー→ラベンダー：30768_rabendaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花畑|はなばたけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Hokkaido to see the lavender fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧{花畑|はなばたけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The flower fields spreading across the hilltop are popular with tourists.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{花畑|はなばたけ}だ。
examples.english: Their head is full of flowers. (They're living in dreamland.)
When you fall in love, your head turns into a flower field. (You become starry-eyed.)

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{花畑|はなばたけ}で、⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えていない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: That person is living in la-la land and can't see reality.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) and ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (field). The literal meaning is straightforward, but the figurative usage ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{花畑|はなばたけ} (head full of flowers) is very common in casual speech and online.

USAGE:
The expression ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{花畑|はなばたけ} or お{花畑|はなばたけ} describes someone blissfully naive or out of touch with reality. It can be used self-deprecatingly about being love-struck, or critically about someone ignoring problems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花畑|はなばたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ — flower fields spread out
- お{花畑|はなばたけ} — flower garden (with polite お); also used for the figurative sense
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{花畑|はなばたけ} — head full of flowers; starry-eyed, naive

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{花園|はなぞの}→花園：24556_hanazono⟧ — flower garden; more literary and poetic
- ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ — field, farm; the general word for cultivated fields
